events.titleZh: Italian Festa：周末走进小意大利
events.summaryZh: 在皇家展览馆和户外广场逛意大利美食与手作摊位，听现场音乐、看文化表演。大人孩子都能找到好吃好逛的角落；主会场免费，部分品鉴与爵士专场另售票。
events.summaryEn: Explore Italian food, makers and cultural performances around the Royal Exhibition Building and its grounds, with live music throughout. A shared family wander; main entry is free, while selected tastings and jazz sessions require separate tickets.
events.placeZh: Royal Exhibition Building 及周边场地，9 Nicholson Street，Carlton
events.placeEn: Royal Exhibition Building and grounds, 9 Nicholson Street, Carlton
events.priceZh: 主会场免费入场；餐饮、购物与部分专场另付
events.priceEn: Free main entry; food, purchases and selected experiences extra
events.mapQuery: Royal Exhibition Building, 9 Nicholson Street, Carlton
events.referenceZh: Italian Festa & Expo 官方页面，10月16日核实。

linkReview.evidence: Italian Festa & Expo. Saturday 17 October, 11am–10:30pm; Sunday 18 October, 11am–8:30pm. Royal Exhibition Building and grounds, 9 Nicholson Street, Carlton. events.summaryZh: 看创意 billycart 小车沿街竞速，再逛表演、餐饮和家庭活动。适合喜欢车轮与热闹街区的孩子，也给大人一个认识 North Melbourne 社区的下午；观赛不等于报名参赛。
events.summaryEn: Watch creative billycarts race through the streets, then explore performances, food and family activities. Enjoy a lively North Melbourne community afternoon together; spectating is separate from entering the race.
events.priceZh: 免费，无需预约；餐饮另购

events.tagEn: Ascot Vale · Dog and cat festival
events.titleZh: Dog Lovers Festival：看狗狗运动与互动
events.summaryZh: 看飞盘、跳水等狗狗运动展示，认识不同犬种，再按现场安排参加互动。适合全家一起了解动物与照护知识；同日票也能进入 Cat Lovers Festival，但不能带自家宠物入场。
events.summaryEn: Watch dog sports such as disc catching and dock diving, meet different breeds and explore supervised interactions. Learn about animals together; your ticket also includes same-day Cat Lovers Festival entry, but leave your own pets at home.
events.placeEn: Melbourne Showgrounds, Epsom Road, Ascot Vale
events.priceZh: 付费；按日期查看票价，同日猫展入场包含在内；餐饮购物另计
events.priceEn: Ticketed; check selected-date pricing, same-day cat festival entry included; food and purchases extra
events.mapQuery: Melbourne Showgrounds, Epsom Road, Ascot Vale
events.referenceZh: Dog Lovers Festival 官方页面，10月16日核实。
events.referenceEn: Dog Lovers Festival official page, checked 16 October.

linkReview.evidence: Organiser's Melbourne 2026 page and FAQ confirm 17-18 October, 9:30am-5pm daily, Melbourne Showgrounds Epsom Road Ascot Vale. Paid Eventbrite booking via organiser; price not guessed. Same ticket enters Cat Lovers Festival on the same day only, not both dates; personal pets not permitted. FAQ: https://dogloversfestival.com.au/melbourne/visitor-info/frequently-asked-questions/ . Eventbrite retrieval returned 429, so ticket inventory is not guaranteed.

events.titleZh: NBL：带孩子现场看墨尔本联队
events.summaryZh: 和孩子一起看 Melbourne United 对阵 Illawarra Hawks，感受现场攻防与助威气氛。适合愿意坐下来观赛的家庭；官方提供两成人两儿童的家庭票组合，座位与余票需按售票页选择。
events.summaryEn: Watch Melbourne United take on the Illawarra Hawks and enjoy the pace and atmosphere of live basketball together. Suits families ready for a seated sporting outing; official family packages cover two adults and two juniors, subject to seat availability.
events.timeEn: Sunday 18 October, game starts 5pm; doors open 3:30pm
events.placeEn: John Cain Arena, Olympic Boulevard, Melbourne Park
events.priceZh: 付费；按座位查看票价及手续费，可选家庭票
events.priceEn: Ticketed; check seat pricing and fees, family packages available
events.mapQuery: John Cain Arena, Olympic Boulevard, Melbourne Park
events.referenceZh: AXS / Melbourne United 官方页面，10月16日核实。
events.referenceEn: AXS / Melbourne United official page, checked 16 October.

events.tagZh: Fed Square · 免费现场音乐
events.titleZh: 联邦广场免费爵士下午场
events.summaryZh: 听 Rebirth Brass Band、BIGYUKI 与 Allysha Joy 轮番登台，和孩子一起在广场感受铜管、节奏与即兴音乐。可先在13:00从 Southbank 跟随街头巡游，再到联邦广场看演出。
events.summaryEn: Hear Rebirth Brass Band, BIGYUKI and Allysha Joy in a free afternoon of brass, grooves and improvisation. Join the 1pm street parade from Southbank first, or head straight to Fed Square for the stage performances.
events.timeZh: 10月17日（周六）：Southbank 巡游13:00；联邦广场演出13:45、14:30、15:45，下午节目至约17:00
events.timeEn: Saturday 17 October: Southbank parade 1pm; Fed Square performances at 1:45pm, 2:30pm and 3:45pm, afternoon programme until about 5pm
events.placeZh: Fed Square，Swanston Street 与 Flinders Street 交界；巡游从 1 Southbank Boulevard 出发
events.placeEn: Fed Square, corner Swanston and Flinders Streets; parade starts at 1 Southbank Boulevard
events.referenceZh: Melbourne International Jazz Festival 官方页面，10月16日核实。

Header covers afternoon until 5pm. Free/family. This card recommends Saturday music only; Sunday's Soul has a separate dated film card.

events.titleZh: 《心灵奇旅》联邦广场免费放映
events.summaryZh: 带孩子看 Pixar 的《心灵奇旅》，跟着音乐老师 Joe 探索热爱、生活与爵士乐。电影分级 PG，涉及生命与死亡主题，家长可先判断是否适合孩子；户外广场观影留意天气。
events.summaryEn: Watch Pixar's Soul as music teacher Joe explores purpose, everyday life and jazz. Rated PG, with themes of life and death, so consider your child's suitability; check the weather for this outdoor square screening.
events.placeZh: Fed Square，Swanston Street 与 Flinders Street 交界

Rated PG, with themes of life and death, so consider your child's suitability; check the weather for this outdoor square screening.

events.titleZh: Inside Out：边听爵士边玩创作
events.summaryZh: 在现场爵士乐里，用软垫、毡布、绳带一起搭建、画画或跳舞。适合2–7岁儿童与陪同家长共同探索；空间光线偏暗，满额时需要等候，不接待带队团体。
events.summaryEn: Build, draw or dance together with cushions, felt, ribbon and rope while live jazz plays. For children aged 2–7 with an accompanying adult; the space is dimly lit, entry may involve a wait at capacity, and facilitated groups cannot attend.

events.titleEn: Colour: See the World in a New Light
events.summaryZh: 一起试试光线、颜色和视觉错觉互动装置，看眼睛与大脑怎样合作。展览建议5–14岁，也适合家长参与；门票包含 Scienceworks 常设馆入场。
events.summaryEn: Experiment together with light, colour and optical illusions to discover how the eyes and brain work. Recommended for ages 5–14 with adults welcome to join in; admission includes Scienceworks entry.
events.referenceZh: Museums Victoria 官方页面，10月16日核实。
